Company A’s 2018 approach led to two undisclosed indications and broader outreach, before A withdrew over value. A separate 2019 effort around Company C ended without a transaction, while merger-of-equals talks with Company B and Synacor’s attempted acquisition of Company D lay outside the whole-company contest. In July 2020 Synacor renewed its sale effort, contacted 37 parties, and received whole-company offers from Company E and CLP alongside proposals for individual businesses. Company E entered exclusivity at $2.00 per share, but later replaced its whole-company proposal with a 35% tender offer. After renewed outreach, CLP returned, raised its price from $1.88 to $2.00, and entered definitive negotiation as Company H continued without an offer. CLP ultimately agreed to $2.20 per share in cash and a $3.5 million target termination fee, with signing on February 10 and announcement on February 11, 2021.
